punchline: According to Ruiz, a stranger who calls you stupid has not met you, so he can only be describing the movie in his own head.
thirty_sec: Don Miguel Ruiz imagines saying to you in the street, without knowing you, that you are stupid. It is about me, he says, not about you. If you take it personally you may start wondering how I could know. Ruiz argues that nothing people do is because of you, and that making this a habit dissolves anger, envy and even sadness. His tip is to write it down and stick it on the refrigerator.
